subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"are meant."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the present tense, so we need a verb that matches that tense.
 
• **"Were given" and "will be added"** are both in the past and future tenses, respectively, so they are not appropriate choices.
 
• **"Are deleted"** is also not appropriate, as it implies that the data has already been removed, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Are meant"** is the correct choice, as it indicates that the data in the row is intended to have a certain value or purpose.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

I hope you will find this series helpful__ in developing language skills of the learners through diverse reading __genres__ such as fairy tales, fables, classics, adventure, biography, drama and so on. The prose pieces __**are meant**__ for intensive language study while the poems ______ (4) ______ enable children to develop an ear for ______ (5) ______ and rhythm.
